body.name: rank-two short-panel law class
body.construction: \(\mathcal M=\{P=P^{(N)}:3\le T<\infty,\ 1\le C<\infty,\ |S_c|\ge3,\ O_1,\ldots,O_N\stackrel{\mathrm{iid}}{\sim}P_O,\ O_i=(C_i,J_{C_i}Y_i(0)),\ Y_i(0)=\Gamma\lambda_i+\varepsilon_i,\ \operatorname{rank}(\Gamma)=2,\ \Gamma^{\prime}\Gamma=I_2,\ \min_cp_c\ge p_{\star},\ v_{\star}I_2\preceq H_c\preceq v^{\star}I_2,\ \mathbb E_P[\varepsilon_i\mid C_i=c]=0,\ \operatorname{Cov}_P(\lambda_i,\varepsilon_i\mid C_i=c)=0,\ \operatorname{Cov}_P(\varepsilon_i\mid C_i=c)=\sigma_c^2I_T,\ \lambda_2(\Gamma_{S_c}H_c\Gamma_{S_c}^{\prime})\ge g_{\star},\ \max_c\mathbb E_P[\|\lambda_i\|^{4+\delta}+\|\varepsilon_i\|^{4+\delta}\mid C_i=c]\le M_{\mathrm{mom}},\ \Gamma\text{ is relation-matroid generic}\}\) for deterministic \(S\), with the cohort conditions holding for every \(c\in[C]\).
